title: LPK Tritama Karya Maharani
decision: The client runs the site. We do not hold the keys.
summary: A website for an accredited job-training centre that prepares Indonesian workers for jobs in Malaysia, Singapore and Hong Kong. Visitors check whether they qualify, practise phrases and register in three steps. Staff change every text and photo from their own admin.
status: Live on the client's own domain. Their staff manage it themselves and have already changed the admin password, so the sign-in screen is all we show of the back office.

title: Puri Bintaro Physiotherapy Clinic
decision: Bookings land in WhatsApp, where the clinic already answers.
summary: A website for a physiotherapy practice run by its owners. The appointment form turns into a ready-written WhatsApp message and refuses Sundays, when the clinic is closed. Google reviews refresh by themselves every morning, and the owners edit services, articles and photos from the admin.
status: Live. The owners are still sending photos for a few services, which they upload through the admin.

title: SMART Kitchen Set
decision: No prices on the page, because every kitchen is measured first.
summary: A website for a kitchen set and furniture workshop in Serpong that has been building since 1998. The portfolio can be filtered by room, and consultation requests arrive in an admin inbox where each one moves from new to contacted, surveyed and closed.
status: Live. The client is choosing a domain name.

title: 3D Showroom for a Glass & Aluminium Business
decision: Let customers see the door before they ask the price.
summary: A business website with a 3D room customers can walk around. They change the model, colour, glass and size of a door or window, then see the result and an estimated price right away.
status: The full version runs locally. The demo here is the 3D room itself, with the business name withheld and illustrative prices.

title: ATLAS — AI Travel Concierge
decision: The AI reads the request. It never sets the price.
summary: A travel booking application. Customers describe what they need in plain language and the system assembles complete hotel options with prices. The AI only reads the request. Every price is recalculated on the server.
status: A live prototype with a real database. The inventory is sample data and the payment step is simulated.

title: TBAGSBOOK — Digital Reading Platform
decision: There is no password to steal, because there is no password.
summary: A platform for reading books and comics, with a personal library, comments and a points system. Security is built in throughout: Google sign-in, mandatory two-factor authentication, server-side session control and login rate limiting.
status: Live online. Its content opens only after sign-in, so the project page walks through it with screenshots.

title: SALVE.CO — Boxy Tee Drop Site
decision: The sale happens in chat, so every button starts that chat.
summary: A website for a clothing label's three-tee drop, built around the idea of an album tracklist. The order button opens WhatsApp with the product name already written, and a small player bar keeps it within reach while people scroll.
status: Live online. There is no cart or online payment: price, stock and shipping are settled in chat.

title: NOIRE — Fashion Brand Landing Page
decision: One file, no framework, almost nothing to break.
summary: A landing page for a concept clothing brand, written as a single HTML file with no framework, so it stays light and opens quickly.
status: Live online. The brand is a concept, not a real client.

title: Macro Divergence Terminal
decision: Measure which markets matter instead of guessing.
summary: A website that compares the Indonesian stock index with the global indices actually correlated to it, and flags the days it moves on its own. The data updates itself with no server to maintain.

title: Equity Terminal
decision: When a number is missing, it says UNKNOWN.
summary: A tool that turns raw financial statement data into a structured report on profitability, valuation, credit risk and scenarios. It runs entirely in the browser, with no account and no installation.
